description: Dawn awakening of the Divine Couple, morning mangala aarti, and melodious flute vibrations echoing across the groves.
The sakhis lovingly adorn Shri Radha-Krishna with fine silk garments, fragrant sandalwood paste, and fresh jasmine garlands.
Krishna gathers cows and comrades for pasturing in the green meadows of Braj with sweet flute melodies.
Sumptuous offering of 56 delicacies prepared by Shri Radha Maharani, followed by soothing afternoon rest and kirtan.
Gentle waking of the deities with cooling drinks, sweet seasonal fruits, and soft musical chanting.
Cows return home under the twilight sky while evening snacks and warm milk are loving offered.
Solemn evening aarti with hundred-wick camphor lamps, sacred conch resonance, and ecstatic kirtan by rasik devotees.
The intimate moonlit ras-lila in the sacred groves of Seva Kunj and Nidhiban, followed by the peaceful rest of the Divine Couple.
